title: File control: READ UPDATE TOKEN, then REWRITE TOKEN or DELETE TOKEN with the token it returned; INVREQ RESP2 47 for a token no READ UPDATE returned

scenarios.summary: REWRITE TOKEN with a token no READ UPDATE returned is INVREQ RESP2 47; READ UPDATE TOKEN then REWRITE TOKEN of its token changes the record
DELETE TOKEN with a token no READ UPDATE returned is INVREQ RESP2 47; READ UPDATE TOKEN then DELETE TOKEN of its token removes the record
